MARKS.d: You ran one. The instrument is no longer a thing you are reading about.
Seven days in a row. This is where it stops being a decision each morning.
Thirty in a row. The nervous system has had long enough to believe you.
A quarter of a year, unbroken. Nothing about this is a beginner number.
An hour of practice on the record, however it was spread.
Ten distinct addresses opened. Not ten runs. Ten places.
Fifty. Close to half the architecture has been opened at least once.
You told it something true and let it read the charge out of that.
Ten told. The field is being read from your own words and not from a form.
Every one of the nine has a value you entered. Nothing is a default.
The intake is complete, so integrity is measured rather than assumed.
You named your type, and the field carries that until you move it.
Six values placed. The compass has something to point at.
An address that was carrying is held at the far pole instead.
Five addresses holding the opposite. That is structure, not a good day.
Ten readings on file, so the movement is yours to see and not to recall.
